name: Qwen Image 2.1 (Exact)
note: [Qwen Image 2.1](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1) supports text-to-image generation, reference-image editing, and native transparency. Provide reference images through the canvas and moodboard, or omit images for text-to-image. For transparent output, explicitly request an RGBA image with an alpha channel and a transparent background. Start with 40 DDIM Trailing steps, Text Guidance 1, and Shift 1 with resolution-dependent shift enabled.
